Metric: Same-month sales growth vs prior year
Rationale: Flags any month whose sales exceed the same month of the prior year by more than 30%. Underlying trend growth is about 11%, so 30% isolates unusual months. Illustrative—not an industry standard.

Metric: Debtor days change vs prior year
Rationale: Debtor days = closing trade receivables / annual credit sales x 365. An increase of more than 10 days indicates slower collection. Illustrative—not an industry standard.

Metric: Operating expense account change vs prior year
Rationale: Flags an operating expense account that rises more than 50% year on year. Applied to every account in category Operating Expenses. Illustrative—not an industry standard.

Metric: Operating expense account variance vs budget
Rationale: Flags an operating expense account whose current-year actual exceeds budget by more than 25%. Applied to every budgeted Operating Expenses account. Illustrative—not an industry standard.
